title: VPN connection fails after password reset
content: User reports VPN client throws error code 691 after a password reset. Steps to reproduce: 1) Reset domain password via self-service portal 2) Attempt VPN login with new credentials 3) Authentication fails with error 691. Workaround: IT helpdesk re-provisions the VPN token. Root cause: cached Kerberos tickets are not flushed automatically on password change. Resolution: Run 'klist purge' on the client machine, then re-authenticate.

title: Laptop screen flickering on dock
content: Multiple users report external monitor flickering when docked. Affected hardware: Dell Latitude 5540 with Thunderbolt dock. Flickering occurs at resolutions above 1080p. Workaround: Downgrade display driver to version 30.0.15063.6010. Root cause: Display driver 31.x has a regression with Thunderbolt 4 docks at 4K. Permanent fix: Apply KB5028997 hotfix from vendor.

title: Email delivery delays to external recipients
content: Outbound emails to external domains are delayed by 20-30 minutes. Affected: all @contoso-retail.example.com senders. Investigation found SPF record misconfiguration — the IP range 203.0.113.0/24 was added to Exchange Online but not to the public DNS SPF TXT record. Fix: Updated SPF record to include ip4:203.0.113.0/24. Verification: Send test email and confirm receipt within 2 minutes.

title: Printer offline after network VLAN migration
content: Floor 3 HP LaserJet Pro M428 shows offline after VLAN 20 was migrated to VLAN 30 on 2024-01-15. Printer IP 10.20.0.45 is no longer reachable. Resolution: Reconfigure printer static IP to 10.30.0.45, update DNS A record for printer.contoso-retail.example.com, and re-add printer on affected workstations using the new IP.

title: VPN Access Setup Guide (DEPRECATED — superseded by ALPHA-KB-002)
content: DEPRECATED ARTICLE — This guide describes the legacy Cisco AnyConnect VPN setup. Use ALPHA-KB-002 for current instructions. Legacy steps: 1) Download Cisco AnyConnect 4.9 from the intranet portal at http://intranet.contoso-retail.example.com/vpn-legacy. 2) Enter server address vpn-old.contoso-retail.example.com. 3) Authenticate with your domain username and static password. NOTE: This endpoint was decommissioned on 2024-03-01. All connections will be refused.

title: VPN Access Setup Guide (Current — GlobalProtect)
content: Current VPN setup guide. Use Palo Alto GlobalProtect client, not Cisco AnyConnect. 1) Download GlobalProtect from https://vpn.contoso-retail.example.com/globalprotect (requires on-network or existing VPN). 2) Set gateway to vpn.contoso-retail.example.com. 3) Authenticate with your domain credentials plus MFA (Microsoft Authenticator). 4) If you receive error GP-0019, your device certificate may be expired — contact the help desk to re-enrol your device. This guide supersedes ALPHA-KB-001.
